questions: Should the random integers be generated with a uniform distribution over [1, 100] inclusive, or is any distribution acceptable as long as values are within that range?
Should the random number generator be seeded or left to default system randomness? If seeded, what seed should be used?
Is the date string guaranteed to be in the exact format 'YYYY-MM-DD', or should the function handle other common date formats (e.g., 'MM/DD/YYYY')?
Should the plot have any specific styling, labels, title, or axis limits, or is a bare line plot sufficient?
What should happen if the day part of the date is zero or negative (e.g., from an invalid date)?
Should the function close or clear any existing matplotlib figures before creating the new plot?
Is the day of the month interpreted in UTC/local time, or is timezone irrelevant?
Should the line plot use x-axis values as indices (0..n-1) or as the day numbers themselves?
